note: Hand-curated list of major UK-relevant sports events for 2026, deliberately maintained by hand rather than pulled from a live sports API - low cardinality and stability make a live feed poor value versus a short maintained list (see conversation). Verified against public event calendars 2026-07-13. Does not duplicate the FIFA World Cup 2026 windows already covered in admiral_enriched_calendar_2026.json.

events.name: Winter Olympics (Milano Cortina)
events.planning_implication: UK broadcast audience but not a home Games - some AV/CTV attention-share shift through February, lower cultural salience than a home event.

events.name: Six Nations Rugby
events.planning_implication: Recurring weekend AV audience spikes through Feb-Mar with strong home-nations pull, particularly around Wales and Scotland fixture weekends.

events.name: FA Cup Final
events.planning_implication: Single-day mass-audience AV moment with UK-wide reach - a moment to avoid competing broadly for attention rather than a spend trigger.

events.name: Royal Ascot
events.planning_implication: Niche but affluent-skewing racing week - limited relevance outside targeted OOH or press context.

events.name: Wimbledon
events.planning_implication: High-reach national AV moment, especially finals weekend - fragments daytime TV attention across the fortnight.

events.name: British Grand Prix (Silverstone)
events.planning_implication: Motorsport-skewing national attention moment, single race weekend - modest AV/social context, not a mass tentpole.

events.name: The Open Championship (Royal Birkdale)
events.planning_implication: Golf-skewing older/affluent AV audience week - limited mass-market relevance.

events.name: Commonwealth Games (Glasgow)
events.planning_implication: Home Games in Scotland - meaningful national pride and AV/CTV attention moment, with particular relevance for Scotland-specific creative or geo weighting.
